verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins connects to data sources (Gmail, Drive, Slack, Notion, Figma) and can summarize, draft, and act on that data via plugins/skills, giving AI-generated insights from connected data, but this is framed as tool-use/automation rather than a dedicated analytics/insights feature over the user's own stored data. missing for 10: no evidence of proactive dashboards, analytics summaries, or unprompted 'insights' generation from user data (e.g., trend detection, anomaly surfacing) beyond on-demand chat/skill invocation, and no independent hands-on validation of insight quality.
